title: Aahain Hain Dhoop Hai Aur Jhoola hai ek
body:
Aahain Hain Dhoop Hai Aur, Jhoola hai ek Khali
Asghar ki ujri Maa ne, dunya alag basa li
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek phool ko dehekthi raiti mai dafun kar ke
Bas haat mal raha tha, ujrey chaman ka mali
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehra me sogeya hai jhooley me sonay wala
Zindan me sogayi hai Jhoolay jhulaney wali
<<DIVIDER>>
Aab janay kya kahengey madar se uski Jaakay
Khaimo ko ja rahey hain Shabbir haat khali
<<DIVIDER>>
Dehka Rubab ko jab Sajda e shukar kar kay
Behlool e hajira nay kyun kar nazar jukali
